description: Maharashtra Launches ‘MahaVISTAAR-AI’ to Digitally Empower Farmers with AI-driven Services
body_lead: In a major step toward digital agriculture, the Government of Maharashtra officially launched the ‘MahaVISTAAR-AI’ mobile application, an AI-powered digital platform designed to assist farmers with real-time, personalised agri-advisory services. Hon’ble Chief Minister Mr. Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the initiative during the state-level Kharif season review meeting.
